title: Аудит данных 206 наборов для логики квиза
purpose: Рабочая база аудита, не готовые вопросы покупателю и не утверждённые правила подбора.

scope.component_audit_basis: Full row-by-row audit of the curated 206-set catalog snapshot dated 2026-11-06. Each set-card composition line is captured, quantities and explicit set-card characteristics are recorded, and absent values are marked unknown. Selected cached official-page checks on 2026-11-09 are stored as separate source observations; they are not a live refresh of all 206 pages.
scope.dynamic_question_design: deferred; only per-set rule effects and eligibility proposals are recorded in this audit.
scope.live_source_refresh: not_completed_for_all_206; page-cache observations are dated and never used as current availability or price

sources.official_page_archive_pass: Web search-index results reviewed 2026-11-09; per-set source URLs and crawl-age labels are in records[].full_audit.source_coverage. Cached archive, not live verification.

state_semantics.recorded_in_curated_catalog: перенесено из существующей карточки/тега; ещё не является независимо проверенным правилом
state_semantics.unknown: источник не даёт значения; неизвестное не равно отсутствию
state_semantics.seller_claim: заявление/позиционирование продавца; не независимое подтверждение эффекта или пригодности
state_semantics.component_signal: возможная потребность по названию/классу компонента; не подтверждает эффективность
state_semantics.archive_miss: страница не найдена в доступном поисковом архиве; это пробел доступа, а не отрицательный факт

matching_proposal.why: Есть продавцовое позиционирование; это сигнал пригодности по версии продавца, не доказательство эффективности.
matching_proposal.include_when: Evidence signals support considering a set for the selected need; final include/exclude decisions are deferred until the evidence pool is pruned and owner review is complete. Tags can corroborate/rank but cannot create a positive or negative decision alone.
rank_order: explicit buyer-need match to seller positioning
listed component/item-class match
explicit activity/season/size compatibility where sourced
catalog tags as a tie-breaker only
hard_exclusions: confirmed size mismatch for a size-sensitive included item
live out-of-stock status after runtime refresh
matching_proposal.conflict_handling: Preserve the set and all evidence in the 206-record pool; flag the conflict for later reconciliation rather than pruning now.
unknowns_not_exclusions: unknown size unless a confirmed mismatch is available
matching_proposal.health_claim_rule: Seller-claimed benefits may explain a candidate with attribution; never promise the effect, treat marketing copy as medical advice, or infer a diagnosis.
matching_proposal.commercial_rule: Refresh price and availability at recommendation time; archived values are not current.
matching_proposal.production_approval: not_approved; this is evidence collection and a draft candidate map, not a final eligibility decision

matching_proposal.why: Есть продавцовое позиционирование; это сигнал пригодности по версии продавца, не доказательство эффективности.
matching_proposal.include_when: Evidence signals support considering a set for the selected need; final include/exclude decisions are deferred until the evidence pool is pruned and owner review is complete. Tags can corroborate/rank but cannot create a positive or negative decision alone.
rank_order: explicit buyer-need match to seller positioning
listed component/item-class match
explicit activity/season/size compatibility where sourced
catalog tags as a tie-breaker only
hard_exclusions: confirmed size mismatch for a size-sensitive included item
live out-of-stock status after runtime refresh
matching_proposal.conflict_handling: Preserve the set and all evidence in the 206-record pool; flag the conflict for later reconciliation rather than pruning now.
unknowns_not_exclusions: unknown size unless a confirmed mismatch is available
matching_proposal.health_claim_rule: Seller-claimed benefits may explain a candidate with attribution; never promise the effect, treat marketing copy as medical advice, or infer a diagnosis.
matching_proposal.commercial_rule: Refresh price and availability at recommendation time; archived values are not current.
matching_proposal.production_approval: not_approved; this is evidence collection and a draft candidate map, not a final eligibility decision

source_policy.set_membership_and_quantity: Official set page. Count retail packages/items in the set separately from package_contents (capsules, tablets, servings, grams, or millilitres); a package-size number is never the set quantity. Ambiguous or unstated set multipliers remain unknown.
source_policy.component_characteristics: Record each fact stated on the official set card. Use separate product/manufacturer pages only where an explicit source URL is attached; without that source, product-level ingredients, servings, allergens, form, and specifications remain not independently verified and must not drive quiz matching.
source_policy.seller_positioning: record as seller claim, not independent proof of suitability
source_policy.catalog_tags: supporting index only; never treat a missing tag as a confirmed negative
source_policy.conflicts: preserve the conflict and keep the affected quiz decision pending until resolved
source_policy.currentness: Catalog content and price snapshot are dated 2026-11-06. Cached pages observed 2026-11-09 may be older; current price and availability are unknown until runtime refresh.

eligibility_policy.conditional_candidate: Provisional evidence candidate only; signal strength and eligibility remain under review until all records are compared and the owner prunes/approves the pool.
eligibility_policy.hold_for_source_resolution: Conflict-review flag: preserve the set and every competing signal in the evidence pool; resolve before a final include/exclude decision.
eligibility_policy.hold_until_available: Do not permanently hold a set based on cached availability; require a live price/availability check at recommendation time.
runtime_requirements: unknown is never treated as confirmed absence
eligibility_policy.owner_approval: All eligibility proposals require owner review before production.
eligibility_policy.evidence_collection_scope: All 206 records and confirmed/unconfirmed signals are retained in the pool. No final pruning or production eligibility decision has been made.
eligibility_policy.source_conflict_handling: Flag for review while preserving all evidence and candidate signals; do not silently delete from the pool.

audit_completion.completion_boundary: Every one of 206 records now has a maximum evidence pool and draft candidate map; no set was removed from this evidence audit. The map uses the 2026-11-06 curated snapshot plus 2026-11-09 search-index page results where available. 74 page URLs returned no result in that archive; captured pages range from component-section excerpts to partial text. Missing/old archive content is an explicit access gap, not proof of absence. Product-level and health-effect claims remain seller claims unless independently sourced. Current price and stock require runtime refresh.
audit_completion.seller_page_archive_note: Search-index archive only; crawl-age labels are stored per observation. This does not verify live/current page state.
audit_completion.seller_claimed_effect_categories: classified per record where visible; no independent medical/scientific efficacy review performed
audit_completion.sports_and_activity_scope: per record split into seller positioning, component-name signals, secondary page mentions, and auxiliary catalog tags; keyword mentions do not prove exclusivity
audit_completion.full_candidate_logic: per-record evidence tiers, soft relevance signals, unresolved source blockers, and dynamic topic triggers recorded; hard activity exclusivity is not inferred from keyword mentions
audit_completion.recommendation_eligibility: not_finalized; evidence pool retained pending later review

evidence_tiers.seller_positioned: Формулировка продавца; подтверждает позиционирование, не эффективность.
evidence_tiers.component_based: Название/состав перечисленного компонента; факт карточки набора, не доказательство эффекта.
evidence_tiers.independently_verified: Отдельная карточка товара/производителя с явным URL; только отмеченные строки.
evidence_tiers.unknown: Источник не даёт ответа; неизвестное не исключает и не подтверждает совместимость.
evidence_tiers.conflict: Части карточки/версии расходятся; решение удерживается до проверки.
evidence_tiers.secondary_page_copy: Seller copy found outside the main set-positioning section; retained as a weaker, manually reviewable signal, not a standalone filter.
